newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican President Zedillo to give New Year address.
newsitem.headline: Mexican President Zedillo to give New Year address.

text.p: President Ernesto Zedillo will give his annual New Year address on Monday evening, the president's office said.

The address, which is usually directed toward the general public and is not normally an overt political statement, will be broadcast at different times by various television stations throughout the evening and into the night.
His office said Zedillo would "make a new call for continuity in the fight for economic and social development in the year, given the most alarming indicators of the crisis have been overcome."
The earliest time the address will be broadcast is 1900 local/0100 GMT Tuesday on Channel 13. The final broadcast will be at 2230 local/0430 GMT on Channel 2.
